# .NET Blazor Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > .NET

## Overview

Builds interactive web applications with Blazor Server and Blazor WebAssembly including component design, state management, and JS interop

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [dotnet-blazor-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
dotnet-blazor-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@dotnet-blazor-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build Blazor components with parameters and events
- Implement Blazor Server and WebAssembly hosting models
- Design state management with cascading values
- Create JS interop for browser API access

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Blazor Component Model**: Component lifecycle and rendering patterns
- **Blazor Performance**: Virtualization and render optimization
- **bUnit**: Blazor component testing framework
